biggest_catch: The company itself publishes no concrete per-survey payout on its official site — the famous '$3 per survey' figure comes only from third-party reviews — and membership is invitation-only, so most users cannot join on demand; this fails the strict official-terms bar (same reason R0213 Nielsen was rejected).
catches: Official site states only that members earn 'rewards' for surveys and can redeem at '$10 or more' for VISA gift cards, Amazon gift codes, or 1,800+ gift cards — no per-survey dollar amount from the company itself.
The widely cited $3/300-points per survey figure is third-party lore, not a company-published term.
Membership is invitation-only (official FAQ: invitations when the panel needs your demographic); most people who want to join cannot get in immediately.
Survey volume is low (third-party reports of 1–4 surveys per month) and some rewards are sweepstakes entries, not cash.
Points expire after 12 months without earning activity (third-party report of the official FAQ).

c1.evidence: Pinecone Research is a real operating research panel (Nielsen-owned per third-party sources) with a live official site at pineconeresearch.com.

c2.evidence: FAILED: the official site publishes no concrete per-survey payout — only a $10+ redemption level for VISA/Amazon/1,800+ gift cards, plus a note that 'some rewards are monetary and others are sweepstakes entries.' The $3-per-survey figure is sourced only from third-party reviews.

c3.evidence: Official site states it is 'completely free to join.'

eligibility: Invitation-only; 18+ per third-party sources; US/UK/CA/DE/FR panels per third-party sources. Most applicants cannot join on demand.
notes: Official why-join page loaded live 2026-09-23. It describes rewards qualitatively ('thank-you gifts like gift cards and sweepstakes entries') and sets only a $10 redemption floor — no per-survey rate anywhere on the official page. Combined with invitation-only access (no open enrollment), this cannot verify under the strict criteria.

s1.note: Invitation-only membership; no open sign-up — fails accessibility regardless of terms.

s3.note: No payout timing published on the official page (third-party: bank transfer 3–5 days, gift cards instant).

s4.note: No payout amount claimed on the official page, so nothing weaselly — but nothing concrete either.
